Statement recognition works with some banks, not all. Measured against 40 banks with English-language statements: 2 are read completely, another 12 in part, and 26 not at all.\n\nAlways check the recognised values before you book. Whatever is missing can be corrected by hand, and the recognition rules in the portfolio let you teach it where the value sits.

New bank — how the app learns

There are no recognition rules for this bank yet. With the first statement, the app learns from you where the values sit:

Date: every date found in the statement is offered — choose the value date.

Numbers: as soon as a label is found in the statement, it replaces the field's title — that's the suggestion that gets learned when you save. Tap the pencil icon next to it any time to pick a different label instead.

The entry is learned when you save it, and booked as usual.
